pred_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM customers

SELECT SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) AS Year FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(T1.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212') - (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212') AS consumption_difference

SELECT substr(y.Date, 1, 6) AS YearMonth, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 GROUP BY substr(y.Date, 1, 6) ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND CAST(SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) || SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201308 AND 201311

SELECT y.CustomerID FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' GROUP BY y.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'Discount' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Discount' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discount_difference FROM gasstations
SELECT MAX(Consumption) AS max_monthly_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS percentage FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'

WITH seg AS (SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012 FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY c.Segment), pct AS (SELECT Segment, (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS pct_increase FROM seg) SELECT (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment, (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) AS percentage FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) = '2013-06';

WITH cust AS (SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment), minc AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS mt FROM cust GROUP BY Segment), lowest AS (SELECT cust.Segment, cust.total FROM cust JOIN minc ON cust.Segment = minc.Segment AND cust.total = minc.mt), avgs AS (SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_c FROM lowest GROUP BY Segment) SELECT (SELECT avg_c FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_c FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM, (SELECT avg_c FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_c FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM, (SELECT avg_c FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_c FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME
SELECT COUNT(t.TransactionID) AS transaction_count FROM transactions_1k AS t INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Time FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.ChainID = 11
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM customers AS c INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN products AS p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE substr(t.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND substr(t.Date, 6, 2) = '09'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS premium_percentage FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK'
SELECT T1.Segment FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Date = '2012-08-23' AND T2.Time = '21:20:00'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000 AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGM <= 40 OR T2.IGM >= 400 GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND L.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND P.SEX = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_count FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND p.SEX = 'F' AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) FROM Patient AS P WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT L.ID FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.GOT >= 60)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CRP = '+' AND P.Description IS NULL
SELECT L.name FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed FROM Team_Attributes ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CPK < 250 AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')

SELECT T.team_long_name FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND M.season = '2009/2010' AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND e.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT L.name FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal GROUP BY L.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT L.name, COUNT(M.id) AS match_count FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY match_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, CAST((JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(P.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE PA.sprint_speed >= 97 AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'
SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE substr(birthday, 1, 4) = '1970' AND substr(birthday, 6, 2) = '10'

SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name ORDER BY CAST(SUM(pa.heading_accuracy) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name FROM Team AS T INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012' AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL)

SELECT CAST(SUM(pa.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT L.name FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE M.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY L.name HAVING CAST(SUM(M.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT M.id) > CAST(SUM(M.away_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT M.id)
SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011'

SELECT CAST(SUM(Match.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id) AS avg_home_team_goal FROM Match JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Poland' AND Match.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS left_foot_percentage FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id WHERE substr(p.birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo') - (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye') AS difference

SELECT SUM(t2.overall_rating) / COUNT(t2.id) AS average_overall_rating FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010' AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015' AND t1.height > 170
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.player_api_id) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986' AND T2.defensive_work_rate = 'high'
SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'
SELECT L.name FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE M.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT pl.player_name FROM Player pl JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pl.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pl.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) OR pl.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player) GROUP BY pl.player_api_id, pl.player_name ORDER BY AVG(pa.finishing) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.chanceCreationPassing, T2.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'Ajax' ORDER BY T2.chanceCreationPassing DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'
SELECT T2.overall_rating FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND T2.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'
SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore' AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'

SELECT (a.r - p.r) * 100.0 / p.r AS percentage_higher FROM (SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS r FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk') AS a, (SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS r FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Paulin Puel') AS p
SELECT ta.defenceAggressionClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%'

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'
SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE PA.volleys > 70 AND PA.dribbling > 70
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%' ORDER BY p.birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.date FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND pa.crossing = (SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2 JOIN Player AS p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant') ORDER BY pa.date ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high'
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name FROM Team AS T INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'
SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS difference

SELECT CAST((MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating END) - MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) AS REAL) * 100 / MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating END) AS percentage FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%' AND p.player_name IN ('Landon Donovan', 'Jordan Bowery')
SELECT DISTINCT T2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT League.name FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY League.name ORDER BY COUNT(Match.id) DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) AND preferred_foot = 'left'
SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT T.team_long_name FROM Match AS M JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT races.name FROM races INNER JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId WHERE circuits.country = 'Germany'
SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> '' ORDER BY q.q2 ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes) LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits AS c INNER JOIN races AS r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
SELECT q.q1 FROM qualifying AS q INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Bruno' AND d.surname = 'Senna' AND q.raceId = 354

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.height < 180 AND T2.overall_rating > 70 THEN T1.id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) AS percentage FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
SELECT d.driverRef FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 20 ORDER BY q.q1 DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 592 AND r.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname, d.url FROM lapTimes lt JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId WHERE lt.raceId = 161 AND lt.time LIKE '1:27%'
SELECT DISTINCT c.location, c.lat, c.lng FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
SELECT number FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 903 AND q3 LIKE '1:54%'
SELECT c.url FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE cr.raceId = 9 ORDER BY cr.points DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.url FROM seasons s JOIN races r ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.raceId = 901
SELECT COUNT(T2.driverId) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND T1.year = 2007 AND T2.time IS NULL
SELECT d.code FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 45 AND q.q3 LIKE '1:33%'
SELECT d.nationality FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM races WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = strftime('%Y', (SELECT MIN(date) FROM races)) AND strftime('%m', date) = strftime('%m', (SELECT MIN(date) FROM races));

SELECT AVG(lapTimes.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms FROM lapTimes JOIN races ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId JOIN drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix' AND races.year = 2009
SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 872 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND d.dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(COUNT(res.time) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(res.driverId) AS completion_rate FROM results AS res JOIN races AS ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.date = '1983-07-16'
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.points FROM results AS r INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId ORDER BY r.points DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.name AS race_name, lt.milliseconds FROM lapTimes lt JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT forename, surname, dob, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' AND dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (CAST(r1.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(r2.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) * 100.0 / CAST(r1.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) AS percent FROM results r1 JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r1.driverId JOIN results r2 ON r2.driverId = r1.driverId AND r2.raceId = 854 WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta' AND r1.raceId = 853

SELECT races.name AS race_name, circuits.name AS circuit_name, circuits.location AS location FROM races INNER JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId WHERE strftime('%Y', races.date) = '2005' AND strftime('%m', races.date) = '09'

SELECT races.year, races.name, results.points FROM results INNER JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId INNER JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY races.year ASC, races.round ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.name, r.year FROM results AS res JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong' AND res.position < 20;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(r.raceId) AS percentage FROM results AS r JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.year >= 2010
SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

SELECT r.name AS race_name, r.year AS race_year FROM lapTimes AS lt JOIN drivers AS d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races AS r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher' AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix'

WITH winners AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM results WHERE positionOrder = 1 GROUP BY driverId ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, (SELECT MAX(r.points) FROM results r WHERE r.driverId = w.driverId) AS max_points FROM winners w JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = w.driverId;

SELECT results.positionOrder FROM results INNER JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId INNER JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId WHERE races.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND races.year = 2008 AND drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton'
SELECT d.driverRef FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.position = 1
SELECT MAX(T2.fastestLapSpeed) FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.year = 2009 AND T1.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
SELECT r.time FROM results AS r JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder = 2;
SELECT MAX(cs.points) AS max_points FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE c.nationality = 'British'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId) AS driver_count FROM results AS res INNER JOIN races AS ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2008 AND res.time IS NOT NULL AND res.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM results WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM races) AND raceId > 0)
SELECT DISTINCT T2.name FROM constructorResults AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId WHERE T1.raceId = 291 AND T1.points = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT T1.constructorId FROM constructors AS T1 INNER JOIN constructorResults AS T2 ON T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId WHERE T1.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.points = 0 GROUP BY T1.constructorId HAVING COUNT(T2.raceId) = 2) AS sub

SELECT r.name, r.year, r.round, res.rank FROM results AS res INNER JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId INNER JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY res.rank ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(CAST(T1.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2009
SELECT COUNT(*) AS circuit_count FROM circuits WHERE location = 'Adelaide' AND country = 'Australia'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(r.resultId) AS completion_percentage FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS french_driver_count FROM drivers AS d INNER JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'French' AND lt.milliseconds < 120000

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985 AND r.laps > 50 THEN r.driverId END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(r.driverId) AS percentage FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.fastestLap FROM results AS r JOIN races AS ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = ra.raceId AND ds.driverId = r.driverId WHERE ra.year = 2009 AND ds.position = 1 AND ra.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = 2009)

SELECT code, nationality, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 3) AS t WHERE t.nationality = 'Dutch') AS dutch_count FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 3

WITH race AS (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'), champ AS (SELECT r.milliseconds AS ms FROM results r JOIN race ON r.raceId = race.raceId WHERE r.positionOrder = 1), lastd AS (SELECT r.milliseconds AS ms FROM results r JOIN race ON r.raceId = race.raceId WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.positionOrder DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CAST((lastd.ms - champ.ms) - champ.ms AS REAL) * 100.0 / lastd.ms AS percentage_faster FROM champ, lastd
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE raceId > 50 AND raceId < 100 AND statusId = 2 AND time IS NOT NULL
SELECT c.location, c.lat, c.lng, COUNT(r.raceId) AS times_held FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Austria' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.location, c.lat, c.lng;
SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.code FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971' AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapTime <> ''

SELECT r.year, AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(res.time,1,INSTR(res.time,':')-1) AS REAL)*3600 + CAST(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(res.time,INSTR(res.time,':')+1),1,INSTR(SUBSTR(res.time,INSTR(res.time,':')+1),':')-1) AS REAL)*60 + CAST(SUBSTR(SUBSTR(res.time,INSTR(res.time,':')+1),INSTR(SUBSTR(res.time,INSTR(res.time,':')+1),':')+1) AS REAL)) AS avg_seconds FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.position = 1 AND res.time IS NOT NULL AND r.year < 1975 GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId WHERE q.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, SUM(CAST(p.duration AS REAL)) / COUNT(p.duration) AS avg_duration FROM drivers d JOIN pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 AND p.duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY avg_duration ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.time FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT SUM(r.points) AS points, c.name, c.nationality FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN constructors c ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE ra.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND ra.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.constructorRef, T1.url FROM constructors AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T3.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND T3.year = 2009 ORDER BY T2.time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_accidents FROM (SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.statusId = 3 GROUP BY r.driverId);

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND r.year = 2008 AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.RBC < 3.5
SELECT AVG(CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient P WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250)

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.`T-CHO` < 250
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.HGB > 10 AND T2.HGB < 17 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_count, SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_count, SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400

SELECT P.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient P WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE HCT >= 52 GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1984' AND (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50 AND L.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) > 55
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.WBC > 3.5 AND L.WBC < 9.0 AND (L.FG <= 150 OR L.FG >= 450)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000 AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.IGA > 80 AND L.IGA < 500 AND strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) >= '1990'
SELECT P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE IGM <= 40 OR IGM >= 400) GROUP BY P.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(P.Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.RNP IN ('-', '+-') AND P.Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CRP = '+' AND P.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND P.SEX = 'F' AND E.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND E.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND Laboratory.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND Patient.SEX = 'M'
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) FROM Examination E JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CPK < 250 AND (E.KCT = '+' OR E.RVVT = '+' OR E.LAC = '+')
SELECT L.name FROM Match M JOIN League L ON L.id = M.league_id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT L.name FROM Match M JOIN League L ON L.id = M.league_id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT t.team_long_name, ta.buildUpPlaySpeed FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id ORDER BY ta.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT L.name, COUNT(M.id) AS match_count FROM Match M JOIN League L ON L.id = M.league_id GROUP BY M.league_id ORDER BY match_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T.team_long_name FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND M.season = '2009/2010' AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id, T.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE PA.sprint_speed >= 97 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', PA.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012' AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012')
SELECT CAST(SUM(pa.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes pa INNER JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE substr(birthday,1,7) = '1970-10'
SELECT T1.name FROM League AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.league_id WHERE T2.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY T1.name HAVING AVG(T2.home_team_goal) > AVG(T2.away_team_goal)

SELECT P.player_name FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.height > 180 GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name ORDER BY CAST(SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) AS REAL) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) FROM Player p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'
SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) FROM Match m JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Poland' AND m.season = '2010/2011'
SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011'

SELECT player_name FROM (SELECT p.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_f FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) OR p.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player) GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name) ORDER BY avg_f DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(pa.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(pa.id) FROM Player p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 170 AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) >= '2010' AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) <= '2015'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon','Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo') - (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye') AS difference
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986' AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'high'
SELECT player_name FROM Player ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.volleys > 70 AND pa.dribbling > 70
SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'
SELECT COUNT(m.id) FROM Match AS m JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT ta.chanceCreationPassing, ta.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Ajax' ORDER BY ta.chanceCreationPassing DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT L.name FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE M.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN PA.overall_rating END) AS REAL) - SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN PA.overall_rating END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN PA.overall_rating END) FROM Player AS P INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
SELECT pa.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%' ORDER BY p.birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore' AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'
SELECT ta.defenceAggressionClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%'

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)

SELECT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes) GROUP BY p.player_api_id

SELECT pa.date FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND pa.crossing = (SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes pa2 JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant') ORDER BY pa.date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN PA.overall_rating END) AS REAL) - SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN PA.overall_rating END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN PA.overall_rating END) FROM Player_Attributes AS PA INNER JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(PA.date, 1, 10) = '2013-07-12'
SELECT id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 4
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS difference
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name FROM Team t JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high'
SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes ta JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT L.name FROM Match M JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE pa.player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1
SELECT t.team_long_name FROM Match m JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE m.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)
SELECT d.driverRef FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 20 AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND q.q1 <> '' ORDER BY q.q1 DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.height < 180 AND T2.overall_rating > 70 THEN T1.id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> '' ORDER BY q.q2 ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes) LIMIT 1
SELECT q.q1 FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 354 AND d.forename = 'Bruno' AND d.surname = 'Senna'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.time IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT number FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = 903 AND q3 LIKE '1:54%'
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname, d.url FROM lapTimes l JOIN drivers d ON l.driverId = d.driverId WHERE l.raceId = 161 AND l.time LIKE '1:27%'
SELECT c.url FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE cr.raceId = 9 ORDER BY cr.points DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.code FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 45 AND q.q3 LIKE '1:33%'
SELECT s.url FROM seasons s JOIN races r ON r.year = s.year WHERE r.raceId = 901
SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 872 AND r.time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.raceId = 592 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND d.dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT d.nationality FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM races WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', date) = (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) FROM races)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.points FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId ORDER BY r.points DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT l.time, d.forename, d.surname, r.name FROM lapTimes l JOIN drivers d ON l.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId WHERE l.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes)

SELECT AVG(lapTimes.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes JOIN drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId JOIN races ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton' AND races.year = 2009 AND races.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(r.driverId) AS completion_rate FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.date = '1983-07-16'

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 853 THEN CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) END) AS REAL) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 854 THEN CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 853 THEN CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) END) AS percent_faster FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' AND d.surname = 'di Resta' AND r.raceId IN (853, 854)

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.raceId) FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.year >= 2010

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, (SELECT MAX(ds2.points) FROM driverStandings ds2 WHERE ds2.driverId = d.driverId) AS max_points FROM drivers d JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.driverId = d.driverId WHERE ds.wins >= 1 GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY SUM(ds.wins) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.year = 2005 AND strftime('%m', r.date) = '09'
SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) AS age, forename, surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT lat, lng FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Silverstone Circuit'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T2.driverId = T3.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Alex' AND T3.surname = 'Yoong' AND T2.position < 20

SELECT r.name, res.points FROM results res JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY r.year ASC, r.round ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix'
SELECT d.driverRef FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.positionOrder = 1

SELECT r.name, r.year FROM lapTimes l JOIN drivers d ON l.driverId = d.driverId JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Michael' AND d.surname = 'Schumacher' AND l.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(l2.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes l2 JOIN drivers d2 ON l2.driverId = d2.driverId WHERE d2.forename = 'Michael' AND d2.surname = 'Schumacher')
SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
SELECT r.time FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId WHERE ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2008 AND r.positionOrder = 2

SELECT T3.name FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T1.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.rank > 0 ORDER BY T1.rank ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.positionOrder FROM results AS T1 JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T1.driverId = T3.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2008
SELECT MAX(cr.points) FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId WHERE c.nationality = 'British'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT r.driverId FROM results r WHERE r.driverId IN (SELECT r2.driverId FROM results r2 JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r2.raceId WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND r2.time IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY r.driverId HAVING COUNT(r.raceId) > 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits WHERE location = 'Adelaide' AND country = 'Australia'

SELECT results.fastestLapSpeed FROM results INNER JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND races.year = 2009 AND results.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(results.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId WHERE cs.raceId = 291 AND cs.points = 0

WITH r AS (SELECT res.positionOrder, res.time FROM results res JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND res.time IS NOT NULL), champ AS (SELECT (CAST(substr(time,1,1) AS REAL)*3600 + CAST(substr(time,3,2) AS REAL)*60 + CAST(substr(time,6,2) AS REAL) + CAST(substr(time,9,3) AS REAL)/1000.0) AS secs FROM r WHERE positionOrder = 1), last AS (SELECT CAST(REPLACE(time,'+','') AS REAL) AS inc FROM r WHERE positionOrder = (SELECT MAX(positionOrder) FROM r)) SELECT last.inc * 100.0 / (last.inc + champ.secs) AS pct FROM champ, last

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT cr.constructorId FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE c.nationality = 'Japanese' AND cr.points = 0 GROUP BY cr.constructorId HAVING COUNT(cr.raceId) = 2)
SELECT T1.fastestLap FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.year = 2009 AND T1.time LIKE '_:%:__.___'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM results r JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT AVG(CAST(results.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE races.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND races.year = 2009 AND results.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American'

SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) FROM drivers d JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'French' AND l.milliseconds < 120000
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code) AS codes, SUM(CASE WHEN nationality = 'Dutch' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dutch_count FROM (SELECT code, nationality FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 3)

SELECT r.year, AVG((CAST(substr(res.time,1,1) AS INTEGER)*3600) + (CAST(substr(res.time,3,2) AS INTEGER)*60) + CAST(substr(res.time,6,2) AS INTEGER) + CAST(substr(res.time,9,3) AS REAL)/1000.0) AS avg_seconds FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.position = 1 AND res.time IS NOT NULL AND r.year < 1975 GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY r.year
SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.code FROM drivers d JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971' AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE statusId = 2 AND time IS NOT NULL AND raceId > 50 AND raceId < 100
